author: karpathy

@haider1 It’s conceptually simple. Always tokenize strings in the “ordinary” way, as sequence of utf8 bytes and that’s it. No string gymnastics. Then add special tokens.

I think Tokenizer APIs in common libraries should delete the option (these are even default on!) to do anything else.

author: karpathy
text:
SQL injection-like attack on LLMs with special tokens

The decision by LLM tokenizers to parse special tokens in the input string (<s>, <|endoftext|>, etc.), while convenient looking, leads to footguns at best and LLM security vulnerabilities at worst, equivalent to SQL injection https://t.co/YQmWHfep6l
